rationale.oversight-explanation: External explanation packs and traces enable efficient human verification and contestation.
rationale.oversight-theater: Framework directly addresses uninformed human rubber-stamping and merely symbolic oversight.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Specifies checkpoints, vetoes, substitutions, circuit breakers, and approve-with-reasons controls.
rationale.risk-routing: Impact, uncertainty, novelty, and divergence determine human review depth and priority.
rationale.ai-review: Independent AI checkers detect disagreements requiring additional human verification.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Linters, constraint tests, rubric checkers, and citation audits provide grounded detection.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Goal ledgers and drift monitors detect departures from declared objectives.
rationale.org-governance: Defines roles, policy ledgers, change controls, sampling, logging, and accountability routines.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent causal traces and appeal bundles make AI actions human-auditable.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes zero-sum claims that meaningful human control necessarily destroys AI agency.
rationale.framework: Provides a reusable mechanism catalogue and four integratable end-to-end oversight patterns.
rationale.design-only: Specifies buildable mechanisms, thresholds, interfaces, and workflows without implementation evidence.
rationale.general-ai: Framework governs general agentic AI decisions and documents, not coding specifically.
rationale.agentic: AI autonomously produces complete decisions, documents, reports, and ranked issue lists.
rationale.steering: Humans may adjust objectives, constraints, trade-off parameters, and future system behavior.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Mechanisms explicitly mitigate plausible-output rubber-stamping and insufficient critical examination.
rationale.risk-bias: Framework operationalizes fairness targets, slice deltas, weighting disclosure, and counter-evidence.
